      "reasoning":"A legitimate customer may use a foreign-issued card and ship to a new non-home address. The passed id_check establishes that the customer holds both the payment instrument and the account identity."

  "next_check":"none",
  "memo":"R03 holds because the FR-issued card was used from a US IP and CVV failed. No other rule holds; Card is the only adverse family, and no household exception applies. No earlier outcome settles the order. Under §6.6(b), id_check was the required verification; it passed, so §5.3(a) requires clear and prohibits further adverse action. A legitimate foreign-card purchase with new non-home shipping is plausible, and verification resolves the stolen-card concern. Recommend clear with no further check."
